title: Team logos and scorebug effects (experimental, unwitnessed)
summary: Bind native team panels and show timeout counts, score flashes, down refresh and play-clock urgency.

gui.reason: EXPERIMENTAL / UNWITNESSED. Enable only in the experimental preset after the protected integration handoff.

input_constraints: User-owned pinned NFL 2K5 USA disc with retail HUD resources, or a completely recognized runtime installation.
Use a disposable output copy; reserve the selected allocator owner union before installing hooks.
An XBE alone cannot install the required 264 native panel textures. Rebuild from base when changing the owner set.
portme: Apply the runtime scorebug section of WIRING.md and regenerate the reservation manifest.
Complete Noah's boot, team identity, scoring, timeout, clock, down-slide and next-game witness list.

public_distribution.rule: Distribute the compiler and recipes; derive native resources from the user's own disc. Do not distribute generated game resources, executables or discs.

runtime.scope: Static analysis and bounded Unicorn execution prove the native descriptor relocation, lookup, binding and event paths. Actual kernel loading, asynchronous collection lifetime, GPU rendering, memory pressure and gameplay remain unwitnessed.

fields.name: scorebug_runtime
fields.allowed: false by default; true only for an experimental disc build

selectors.notes: Implies scorebug and xbe_space. Relocated kickoff is independent and requires its existing alignment prerequisites.

source_container.format: XBE and native TXTR/SCNE resources in XDVDFS pack 0
source_container.retail_file: user-owned default.xbe and vc_53450030/0 in an NFL 2K5 USA disc
source_container.resource: owned RX/RW hook allocations plus HUD outer 346 and its archive index
